import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static Map<Integer, Integer>[] networkGraph = new HashMap[7000];
    static char[][] mazeGrid = new char[20][20];
    static int rows, cols, totalNodes, targetDist[][] = new int[10][10];
    static int[] parentArray = new int[7000], flowArray = new int[7000];

    static {
        for (int i = 0; i < networkGraph.length; i++) {
            networkGraph[i] = new HashMap<>();
        }
    }

    static int computeFlow(int s, int t, int cap) {
        int totalFlow = 0;
        for (int iter = 0; iter < 1; iter++) {
            Arrays.fill(parentArray, -1);
            parentArray[s] = s;
            flowArray[s] = cap;
            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            q.offer(s);
            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int u = q.poll();
                if (u == t) {
                    for (int v = u; v != s; v = parentArray[v]) {
                        int parent = parentArray[v];
                        networkGraph[parent].put(v, networkGraph[parent].get(v) - flowArray[t]);
                        networkGraph[v].put(parent, networkGraph[v].getOrDefault(parent, 0) + flowArray[t]);
                    }
                    totalFlow += flowArray[t];
                    break;
                }
                for (Map.Entry<Integer, Integer> entry : networkGraph[u].entrySet()) {
                    int v = entry.getKey();
                    int capacity = entry.getValue();
                    if (capacity >= cap && parentArray[v] == -1) {
                        parentArray[v] = u;
                        flowArray[v] = Math.min(capacity, flowArray[u]);
                        q.offer(v);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return totalFlow;
    }

    static int encodeNode(int x, int y, int t) {
        return x + y * rows + t * rows * rows + 2;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        rows = sc.nextInt();
        cols = sc.nextInt();

        int totalRes = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < rows; i++) {
            String line = sc.next();
            for (int j = 0; j < rows; j++) {
                mazeGrid[i][j] = line.charAt(j);
                if (mazeGrid[i][j] > '0' && mazeGrid[i][j] <= '9') {
                    networkGraph[0].put(encodeNode(i, j, 0), mazeGrid[i][j] - '0');
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < rows; i++) {
            String line = sc.next();
            mazeGrid[i] = line.toCharArray();
        }

        int[] dx = {-1, 0, 1, 0};
        int[] dy = {0, -1, 0, 1};

        for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 10; j++) {
                targetDist[i][j] = cols + 1;
            }
        }

        Queue<int[]> qBfs = new LinkedList<>();
        for (int i = rows - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            for (int j = rows - 1; j >= 0; j--) {
                if (mazeGrid[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    targetDist[i][j] = 0;
                    qBfs.offer(new int[]{i, j});
                }
            }
        }

        while (!qBfs.isEmpty()) {
            int[] p = qBfs.poll();
            int i = p[0], j = p[1];
            for (int dir = 0; dir < 4; dir++) {
                int t = targetDist[i][j];
                int x = i + dx[dir], y = j + dy[dir];
                if (x >= 0 && y >= 0 && x < rows && y < rows && mazeGrid[x][y] != 'Y' && t + 1 < targetDist[x][y]) {
                    targetDist[x][y] = t + 1;
                    qBfs.offer(new int[]{x, y});
                }
            }
        }

        totalNodes = encodeNode(rows - 1, rows - 1, cols) + 1;

        for (int i = 0; i < rows; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < rows; j++) {
                for (int t = 0; t < cols; t++) {
                    if (t < cols) {
                        for (int q = 0; q < 4; q++) {
                            int x = i + dx[q], y = j + dy[q];
                            if (x >= 0 && y >= 0 && x < rows && y < rows && mazeGrid[x][y] != 'Y' && t + 1 < targetDist[x][y] + (mazeGrid[x][y] > '0' && mazeGrid[x][y] <= '9' ? 1 : 0) && t < targetDist[i][j]) {
                                networkGraph[encodeNode(i, j, t)].put(encodeNode(x, y, t + 1), 1000);
                            }
                        }
                        if (mazeGrid[i][j] > '0' && mazeGrid[i][j] <= '9') {
                            networkGraph[encodeNode(i, j, t)].put(encodeNode(i, j, cols), mazeGrid[i][j] - '0');
                        }
                    }
                }
                if (mazeGrid[i][j] > '0' && mazeGrid[i][j] <= '9') {
                    networkGraph[encodeNode(i, j, cols)].put(1, mazeGrid[i][j] - '0');
                }
            }
        }

        for (int u = 8; u > 0; u /= 2) {
            totalRes += computeFlow(0, 1, u);
        }
        System.out.println(totalRes);
        sc.close();
    }
}
